label: SYNTHETIC
rule: One registered synthetic coupling case of the model-v2 chain (lane brief item 5), committed alone with its sha256 before its scored run, as the VS-NET and AL-10 v2 registrations. Its numbers are verification inputs, never physical values.
builder: crates/abep-subsystems/tests/support/coupling_smoke.rs::build (the file is its byte-identical output; tests/coupling_smoke_v2.rs checks the bytes and this sha256 and reads every input from the file)
chain: NP-ICP v2 -> IF-ICP-THERMAL-v2 adapter -> NP-THERMAL 2.0.0 (VS-NET, registered transformation of al10_v2_registration_v1.json with the case's f_up and TK-06 split) -> IF-ICP-BUS-v2 -> CONS-L1 v2
pass_criterion: for every producer scenario member: the producer's closures within 1e-10; every IF-ICP-THERMAL-v2 key TK-01..TK-13 lands exactly once (deposited + exported + booked = key within 1e-12 relative + 1e-12 W) and nowhere else; the destinations sum to P_icp_slot_load_sum_W within eps_if and 1e-10; the IF-ICP-BUS-v2 load-plane values enter the ledger exactly; the CONS-L1 v2 ICP account closes within 1e-10 of the slot-load sum and CONS-L1 within 2 %. Fail-closed: a duplicated key, a key under a second name, a dropped key, an unmapped status, a duplicated member and a double-booked share or account are refused.
